race.comment: BESTON STREET (2) has the most solid recent platform after finishing third at this track over 1400m when sent out favourite. The return to 1200m asks a question given his record around the trip, but he is race-fit, has already placed at this venue and brings the strongest exposed form. ANDERSHINE (6) has clear upside from a debut fourth at this track, where he was slow away, held up near the 250m and still finished within just over a length of Aldezor. Better for that run and this looks to shape nicely. Can make an impression. ALOT OF DESIRE (7) is the debut runner with genuine interest after two Belmont trials, both for third, and Natasha Faithfull is a positive booking from barrier one. DIVER DAN (3) comes through a CL1 fourth at this venue when beaten just under two lengths as favourite, and that form back in maiden company gives him a genuine chance to land in the money or better. EIGHT COUNT (5) can improve back to this level.
